newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup signs rehaul MOU with MD.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup signs rehaul MOU with MD.

text.p: SAirGroup said its SR Technics subsidiary had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with McDonnell Douglas to convert 23 DC-10 aircraft into the advanced two-crew-cockpit used in the MD-10 aircraft.
SR Technics said in a statement this would generate turnover of some 60 million Swiss francs and several hundered thousand hours of work for the technical services company.
The converted aircraft will be operated by air cargo carrier Federal Express.
The cooperation forms part of a major conversion programme agreed between McDonnell Douglas, Federal Express and SR Technics involving 120 DC-10 aircraft.
Under the accord, SR Technics will equip 23 of these transporters with new two-crew cockpits, state-of-the-art avionics and new hydraulic, pneumatic and fuel systems.
The work is due to begin in early summer 1999 and will last until 2002 and each conversion takes eight to 10 weeks.
